metadata.title: New inhomogeneous Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds with large symmetry group
metadata.abstract: We study compact non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds whose connected full group of holomorphic isometries acts with cohomogeneity one. We prove that the Lie algebra of this group is isomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^3\oplus\mathfrak{su}(2)$ or $\mathbb{R}^2\oplus\mathfrak{su}(2)$, unless the Bismut connection is flat. We then focus on the first case, where we determine the possible singular isotropy algebras and reduce the Bismut Hermitian-Einstein condition to a system of ordinary differential equations. We obtain explicit solutions satisfying suitable smoothness conditions, that yield families of compact and complete non-compact non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds with non-constant scalar curvature and non-zero Bismut curvature, including examples on $S^3\times S^3$ and $S^3\times S^1\times\mathbb{R}^2$, respectively. We also investigate the topology of the compact examples and determine the asymptotic scalar curvature of the non-compact ones. Moreover, we prove the existence of a smooth deformation of a Bismut-flat Samelson structure on $S^3\times S^3$ through non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein structures that are not Bismut-flat. The regularity of the constructed compact examples is also investigated.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 非齐性 Bismut Hermitian–Einstein 三维复流形构造
analysis.workSummary: 对紧非 Kähler Bismut Hermitian–Einstein threefold，若连通全体全纯等距群余齐性一，除 Bismut 平坦情形外其 Lie 代数只能为 R³⊕su(2) 或 R²⊕su(2)。聚焦第一种，确定可能奇异各向同性代数，将方程化为 ODE 并构造满足光滑条件的紧及完备非紧解族，标量曲率非常数且 Bismut 曲率非零，包括 S³×S³ 与 S³×S¹×R² 上的例子；还给紧例拓扑、非紧例渐近标量曲率及从 S³×S³ 的平坦 Samelson 结构出发的非平坦光滑变形。
techniques: 余齐性一的 Hermitian 几何
Bismut 方程的 ODE 约化
analysis.breakthrough: 以显式解和变形展示高对称但非齐性、非平坦的 Bismut Hermitian–Einstein 几何。
analysis.limitations: threefold 指复维三；Bismut Hermitian–Einstein 不等同 Levi-Civita Einstein，非恒定标量曲率正体现区别。全部 Lie 代数约束不等于两类均完成解分类，具体构造集中于 R³⊕su(2) 情形。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
